story_description: As a user, I want a single unified wizard that combines directory source selection (browse, clone, create) with provider and model selection, so that I can create new sessions with any supported CLI engine without navigating multiple dialogs.
task_description: Wire the new DirectorySource enum (browse, clone, create) and provider/model selection into NewSessionModal, replacing the current browse-only directory selection with a tabbed or segmented approach that handles all three directory source types and passes provider/model to session creation.
atom: A001 Unified Session Creation Modal Implementation
atom_description: Implement the complete session creation flow update by adding DirectorySource state, provider/model pickers, and async directory handling (clone/create) to NewSessionModal.swift, then wire the selected provider and model through to AppState.createSessionWithWorktree.
problem_statement: The current NewSessionModal only supports browsing to an existing directory. Users cannot clone a remote repository or create a new project from scratch. Additionally, the modal has no way to select a provider (Claude, Gemini, Codex) or model before creating a session - it defaults to Claude. This atom integrates directory source types, provider selection, and model selection into a unified creation wizard.
scope_in: Add DirectorySource enum with cases: browse, clone, create
Add @State properties for directorySource, selectedProvider, selectedModelId, repoURL, projectName, initGit
Create tabbed or segmented control for directory source selection
Implement clone flow: validate URL, show progress, call GitWorktreeManager.cloneRepository
Implement create flow: prompt for project name, optional git init, create directory
Add model picker populated via ModelService.models(for:)
Update createSession() to switch on directorySource and handle async clone/create
Update createSessionWithDirectory to pass provider and modelId to AppState
Add validation states: empty URL, invalid URL format, directory exists, clone in progress
Add error handling with user-visible error messages for each failure mode
scope_out: SSH key management for clone authentication (use HTTPS only in MVP)
Custom model ID entry (use predefined ModelService lists only)
Provider authentication flow (handled by CLI login)
assumptions: GitWorktreeManager.cloneRepository exists and returns the cloned directory path
ModelService.models(for:) returns valid model lists for each EngineType
AppState.createSessionWithWorktree can accept provider and modelId parameters or will be updated concurrently
FileManager.default.createDirectory works for the create flow
NSOpenPanel works for the browse flow (already implemented)
constraints: Must not break existing browse-only flow during migration
Must handle async clone operations without blocking UI
Clone progress must be visible to user
Provider/model selection must default to sensible values (Claude/Opus)
Directory creation must check for existing directories and prompt for overwrite or rename
All user-facing strings must be defined in ui_copy for localization readiness
functional_requirements: FR1: User can select directory source type via segmented control (Browse, Clone, Create)
FR2: Browse mode uses existing NSOpenPanel directory picker
FR3: Clone mode shows URL text field with validation (https:// prefix required)
FR4: Clone mode shows async progress indicator during git clone
FR5: Create mode shows project name text field and optional git init toggle
FR6: Create mode validates that target directory does not already exist
FR7: User can select provider from EngineType picker (Claude, Gemini, Codex)
FR8: User can select model from ModelService-populated picker based on selected provider
FR9: Model picker updates when provider changes to show relevant models
FR10: Default selection is Claude provider with Opus model
FR11: Create Session button is disabled until valid configuration exists
FR12: On success, session is created with selected provider and model
FR13: On clone failure, error message is shown and user can retry or cancel
FR14: On create failure (directory exists), user is prompted to choose new name
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR1: Clone operation must show progress within 500ms of starting
NFR2: UI must remain responsive during async clone (no main thread blocking)
NFR3: All text fields must support standard macOS text editing (copy/paste, undo)
NFR4: Tab order must follow logical flow: directory source, then provider, then model, then create button
NFR5: Segmented control must be keyboard accessible
implementation_steps: Step 1: Define DirectorySource enum with browse, clone, create cases in NewSessionModal.swift

Step 2: Add @State properties: directorySource (default: .browse), selectedProvider (default: .claude), selectedModelId (default: ModelService.defaultModel(for: .claude)), repoURL (empty string), projectName (empty string), cloneProgress (optional Double)
Step 3: Create directorySourceSection view with Picker (segmented style) for DirectorySource selection
Step 4: Create browseSection view (extract existing directory selection logic)
Step 5: Create cloneSection view with TextField for URL, validation message, and ProgressView when cloning
Step 6: Create createSection view with TextField for project name and Toggle for git init
Step 7: Create providerSection view with Picker for EngineType selection
Step 8: Create modelSection view with Picker populated from ModelService.models(for: selectedProvider)
Step 9: Add .onChange(of: selectedProvider) to reset selectedModelId to default for new provider
Step 10: Update canCreateSession computed property to validate based on directorySource
Step 11: Update createSession() to switch on directorySource: browse uses existing logic, clone awaits cloneRepository, create calls createNewProject
Step 12: Implement cloneRepository async flow with progress updates
Step 13: Implement createNewProject function that creates directory and optionally runs git init
Step 14: Update createSessionWithDirectory to pass selectedProvider and selectedModelId to appState.createSessionWithWorktree
Step 15: Add error handling for clone failures (network, auth, invalid URL)
Step 16: Add error handling for create failures (directory exists, permission denied)
Step 17: Update previewActions to reflect current directorySource and provider/model selection
Step 18: Add accessibility labels to all new UI elements

ui_states: Initial: Browse tab selected, directory field empty, provider=Claude, model=Opus, Create button disabled
Browse Selected: Directory field shows selected path after NSOpenPanel, git status checking shows spinner
Clone Selected: URL field visible with placeholder text, validation message hidden until URL entered
Clone Validating: URL field has value, validation message shows 'Checking URL format'
Clone Invalid URL: URL field has red border, validation message shows 'Invalid URL: must start with https://'
Clone Ready: URL field has green checkmark, Create button enabled
Clone In Progress: Progress bar visible, Cancel button replaces Create button, URL field disabled
Clone Failed: Error banner visible with retry option, URL field re-enabled
Create Selected: Project name field visible, git init toggle visible, default location shown
Create Name Empty: Project name field empty, Create button disabled
Create Name Valid: Project name filled, Create button enabled
Create Directory Exists: Error message 'Directory already exists', suggest alternative name
Provider Changed: Model picker reloads with models for new provider, resets to default model
Creating Session: All inputs disabled, Create button shows spinner with 'Creating' text and animated dots
Creation Complete: Modal dismisses, new session selected in sidebar
ui_interactions: User clicks segmented control tab to switch directory source
User clicks Browse button to open NSOpenPanel (browse mode)
User types URL into clone URL field with real-time validation
User clicks Create button to start clone with progress indicator
User clicks Cancel during clone to abort and re-enable inputs
User types project name into create name field
User toggles git init checkbox in create mode
User selects provider from provider picker dropdown
User selects model from model picker dropdown (filtered by provider)
User presses Escape or clicks Cancel to dismiss modal without creating session
User presses Return or clicks Create Session to submit form
ui_copy: Browse tab: Select existing project directory
Clone tab: Clone from remote repository
URL Validation Error: URL must start with https://
Clone Progress: Cloning repository (with progress indicator)
Git Init Label: Initialize git repository
Directory Exists Error: A directory with this name already exists
Creating Button: Creating (with animated loading indicator)
edge_cases: EC1: User pastes URL with trailing whitespace - trim before validation
EC2: User enters URL without .git suffix - accept and let git handle it
EC3: Clone fails due to network timeout - show error with retry option
EC4: Clone fails due to repository not found - show specific 404 error message
EC5: Clone fails due to authentication required - prompt user to use HTTPS with token or public repo
EC6: User switches from clone to browse mid-operation - cancel pending clone
EC7: Create directory parent path does not exist - create intermediate directories
EC8: Create directory fails due to permission denied - show permission error message
EC9: User selects Gemini provider but Gemini CLI is not installed - show warning but allow session creation
EC10: Selected directory is inside another git repository - detect nested git and warn user
EC11: Modal is dismissed while clone is in progress - cancel clone task gracefully
EC12: Provider picker has only one option due to missing CLI tools - auto-select and disable picker
failure_modes: FM1: Network failure during clone - show 'Network error: Unable to reach repository' with retry button
FM2: Invalid git URL format - show inline validation error, disable Create button
FM3: Repository requires authentication - show 'Repository requires authentication. Use a public repo or include token in URL'
FM4: Disk full during clone - show 'Disk space error: Not enough space to clone repository'
FM5: Directory creation permission denied - show 'Permission denied: Cannot create directory at this location'
FM6: Git not installed (for clone/create with git init) - show warning banner, disable git-related options
FM7: Clone cancelled by user - clean up partial clone directory, re-enable form inputs
FM8: Session store write failure - show 'Unable to save session' with details, offer retry
rollback_plan: If session creation flow changes cause issues, revert NewSessionModal.swift to the previous browse-only implementation by checking out the pre-change version. The rollback steps are: 1) git checkout HEAD~1 -- Blaze/Sources/UI/NewSessionModal.swift, 2) Rebuild with swift build, 3) Verify existing sessions still load, 4) Test that browse-only creation works. No database migrations are involved so data rollback is not needed.

acceptance_tests: AT1: Given I am on the New Session modal, when I select Clone tab and enter a valid GitHub HTTPS URL and click Create, then the repository is cloned and a new session is created with the cloned directory as worktree

AT2: Given I am on the New Session modal, when I select Create tab and enter a project name and enable git init and click Create, then a new directory is created with .git folder and a session is created
AT3: Given I am on the New Session modal, when I select Gemini as provider, then the model picker shows only Gemini models and the default is Gemini 2.5 Pro
AT4: Given I am cloning a repository, when the clone fails due to network error, then I see an error message with a Retry button
AT5: Given I am on the New Session modal, when I click Cancel during a clone operation, then the clone is cancelled, partial files are cleaned up, and the modal closes
acceptance_criteria: AC1: All three directory source modes (Browse, Clone, Create) are selectable and functional
AC2: Provider picker shows Claude, Gemini, and Codex options
AC3: Model picker dynamically updates based on selected provider
AC4: Clone operations show progress and handle errors gracefully
AC5: Create operations validate project name and handle directory conflicts
AC6: Sessions are created with the correct provider and model from user selection
AC7: All user-facing strings are externalized for localization
AC8: Form validation prevents creation of invalid sessions

Clone operations show progress and handle failures gracefully. The form validates inputs and prevents invalid submissions.
completed_evidence: 1) Screenshot of New Session modal showing all three tabs and provider/model pickers, 2) Test run output showing all NewSessionModalTests passing, 3) Console log showing session_creation_completed event with correct provider and model, 4) Screen recording of successful clone flow with progress indicator, 5) Session list showing newly created session with Gemini engine type.
status_reason: Feature spec complete. Implementation depends on concurrent work on GitWorktreeManager clone method and AppState signature update.
open_questions: Should we support SSH URLs in addition to HTTPS for clone?
Should the default location for Create be ~/Projects or user-configurable?
Should we pre-validate that the selected CLI tool is installed before allowing provider selection?
notes: This atom is part of the E005 Multi-CLI Onboarding epic which enables users to work with Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Codex CLI from a unified interface. The session creation wizard is the first touchpoint where users select their preferred AI provider and model.

risks: Clone operations may hang on slow networks without timeout
Concurrent directory operations could cause race conditions
Provider CLI might not be installed, causing session to fail on first prompt
Model IDs may become stale if providers update their model offerings
mitigations: Add 120-second timeout for clone operations with user-visible countdown
Use file locking when creating directories to prevent races
Add pre-flight check for CLI installation with graceful degradation to available providers
Fetch model lists dynamically in future iteration; for MVP use hardcoded lists
risk_register.blast_radius: Changes are isolated to NewSessionModal UI and AppState session creation. No changes to existing session data model or persistence layer. Existing sessions are unaffected.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If issues arise, revert NewSessionModal.swift changes and ship with browse-only flow. Clone and Create features can be re-added in a subsequent release.
